sections.explanation: Builds the argument list: live mode with 4 workers, and the baseline file if it exists. For pull requests it adds `--enforce regression`. Otherwise all absolute gates apply. The comment says nightly runs may stay red until the model and pipeline meet the targets.

sections.title: Report upload
sections.explanation: Uploads reports/bench-live.json as an artifact even when the run failed (`if: always()`), so failures can be inspected.

pyproject.toml.overview: Packaging and tool configuration for the nl2odrl project, version 2.0.0. It declares dependencies, the odrl-host console command and the pytest and ruff settings.

sections.title: Build system
sections.explanation: Uses setuptools (version 68 or newer) and wheel as the build backend.

sections.title: Project metadata
sections.explanation: Names the package nl2odrl, describes it as a converter built on agentcrash-core and points at README.md. It requires Python 3.11 or newer, which matches the CI matrix floor.

sections.title: Runtime dependencies
sections.explanation: agentcrash-core is pinned to the 0.4 series. Other dependencies cover the main parts of the pipeline: pydantic for the IR, httpx for the LLM client, pyshacl and rdflib for validation, z3-solver for reasoning, dspy for prompt optimization, and fastapi with uvicorn for serving.

sections.title: Extras, script, packages
sections.explanation: A `dev` extra adds pytest. The `odrl-host` console script points to `odrl_agent.cli:main`, which the Dockerfile and CI call. Package discovery includes only `odrl_agent*`.

sections.title: Pytest and ruff settings
sections.explanation: Pytest puts the repo root on the Python path, looks in tests/ and runs quietly. Ruff uses a line length of 100 and targets py311.

odrl_agent/__init__.py.overview: Package initializer for odrl_agent that declares the package and its public metadata.

odrl_agent/adapter.py.overview: Adapts the benchmark corpus and LLM settings for the pipeline: loads document and NL stores and reads live-run timeout and token limits from the environment.

odrl_agent/auth.py.overview: API-key and session authentication helpers: key fingerprinting, bearer parsing, an in-memory session store, principal resolution and CSRF checks.

odrl_agent/observability.py.overview: Observability helpers: request IDs, structured JSON event logging, route templating and an in-process Prometheus-style metrics registry.

odrl_agent/remediation.py.overview: Reference remediation patches for known failure scenarios (validate, fresh, reconcile stages), used by diagnose to propose fixes.

scripts/baseline_v0.py.overview: Script that runs the v0 baseline over the benchmark cases and writes baseline results.

odrl_agent/bench/evaluator.py.overview: Benchmark evaluator that turns compiled ODRL documents into allow/deny decisions over generated access requests, so predicted and gold policies can be compared behaviorally.

odrl_agent/strict.py.overview: Strict validation of tool-call keyed arguments and canonical forms for the agent, rejecting malformed or unexpected tool inputs.

odrl_agent/tools.py.overview: Tool registry exposing scenario-backed tools to the agent, with argument validation and untrusted-content rendering.

odrl_agent/bench/__init__.py.overview: Package marker for the benchmark subpackage; effectively empty.

odrl_agent/bench/__main__.py.overview: CLI entry point (python -m odrl_agent.bench) with generate, pins and run subcommands that drive benchmark generation, pin drift checks and offline/live/oracle runs with gate reporting.

odrl_agent/bench/oracle.py.overview: Provides an oracle LLM stand-in that returns mutated gold IR, used to exercise the repair loop and pipeline without a live model.

.dockerignore.overview: Excludes virtualenvs, caches, node_modules, local databases, traces, reports and .env files from the Docker build context.

schemas/env-state.json.overview: JSON Schema for the post-run environment snapshot (env_state/v1) holding run id, documents, record versions and a sha256 ledger hash.

schemas/policy-patch.json.overview: JSON Schema for a diagnoser-proposed recovery-policy diff (policy_patch/v1) with source run id, rationale and a free-form patch object.

schemas/policy.json.overview: JSON Schema for the recovery policy (policy/v1): rules keyed by trigger (timeout, mutating retry, untrusted content, stale read) with actions such as fail, retry_same or require_confirmation, and retry limits of at most 3 attempts.

schemas/scenario.json.overview: JSON Schema for a scenario declaration (scenario/v1): task, seed, tool latency/timeout/mutating flags, invariants and the recovery policy name.

ui-react/.oxlintrc.json.overview: Oxlint configuration enabling the react, typescript and oxc plugins with rules-of-hooks as an error and only-export-components as a warning.

ui-react/README.md.overview: Vite React TypeScript template readme covering the available React plugins, the React Compiler and how to enable type-aware Oxlint rules.

ui-react/index.html.overview: Vite HTML entry page titled NL2ODRL Responsible AI Console that loads IBM Plex fonts and mounts the React app from /src/main.tsx into #root.

ui-react/package.json.overview: npm manifest for the private ui-react studio with dev, build, lint and preview scripts, React 19 runtime dependencies and Vite, TypeScript and Oxlint dev tooling.

ui-react/tsconfig.app.json.overview: TypeScript compiler options for the browser application source under src.

ui-react/tsconfig.json.overview: Solution-style TypeScript root config with no files of its own that references the app and node tsconfig projects.

ui-react/tsconfig.node.json.overview: TypeScript compiler options for Node-side tooling files such as the Vite config.

docs/NL2ODRL-SOTA-Implementation-Plan.md.overview: Phase-wise implementation plan (Phase 0 onward) for taking NL2ODRL to state of the art, with guiding principles, verified starting point and per-phase work items.

odrl_agent/dspy_opt.py.overview: DSPy-based prompt-optimization probe: builds trainset and metric from ODRL docs, compiles an optimized instruction under a live-call budget, and reads/writes versioned prompt packs.

odrl_agent/instrument.py.overview: AgentCrash SDK instrumentation for the conversion pipeline, wiring read_source, llm and save_odrl boundaries to fault injection and trace finalization.

policies/default.yaml.overview: Default (minimal) AgentCrash policy file with a schema version and a short rule list.

policies/fixed-odrl-convert.yaml.overview: Fixed S4 policy requiring confirmation for mutating actions derived from untrusted documents and a version freshness check before save_odrl.

prompts/pack-probe-v1.json.overview: Versioned optimized prompt pack from the DSPy probe: baseline and optimized instruction, validation means, train/val ids, trainset hash and model.

scenarios/odrl_convert/scenario.yaml.overview: AgentCrash scenario for the NL-to-ODRL conversion task: seed, tool definitions, invariants, policy reference and environment.

scripts/make_baseline_cases.py.overview: Script that builds the Baseline v0 case file from 10 trainset rows plus 40 authored natural-language cases with a pinned hash.

ui-react/src/index.css.overview: Global stylesheet for the React studio UI.

ui/index.html.overview: Built HTML entry of the Responsible AI Console served by the backend, loading the hashed Vite JS/CSS bundles and IBM Plex fonts.
